written_before: any program of this lane read the certificate; the plan is hashed with the checker

conventions.facts: Every rule is stated over the certificate's exact facts as method A computes them on the unmodified file (pair margins, wall clearances (L, B, R, T), senses, the verdict), since those facts are unknown when the plan is written. A rule that predicts a margin or a clearance predicts it exactly, as a rational.
conventions.both methods: Each modified packing is decided by method A, method B and the centre-and-half-width formulation where a margin or clearance is predicted; a control holds only when all of them agree with the rule. Classes: a margin > 0 apart, = 0 touch, < 0 overlap; a clearance > 0 clear, = 0 touch, < 0 cross; method B's classes are its own (clipping) and must equal the class of the predicted value.
conventions.whole files: Whole-file controls write the modified packing with r1012_writer (canonical scalars, the softschema envelope) and read it back through r1012_reader before deciding it.
conventions.first and last: first and last mean the first and the last square in the file's order; index k means the k-th square in that order, from 0.
conventions.verdict prediction: Where a rule predicts the verdict, ACCEPT means every square a unit square, every predicted clearance >= 0 and every predicted margin >= 0, and REFUSE otherwise.
